description: This file contains a report implementation for purchase register in ERPNext, including functions to fetch and process invoice data, generate report columns, and handle related database queries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the purchase register report with optional filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal function that performs the core report data processing and returns columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report columns based on invoice list and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Fetches invoice records from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_invoice_expense_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of invoice expenses from database data.

methods.name: get_internal_invoice_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping for internal invoices with unrealized profit/loss accounts.

methods.name: get_invoice_tax_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of taxes associated with invoices.

methods.name: get_invoice_po_pr_map
methods.description: Maps purchase orders, receipts, and projects to invoices.

methods.name: get_account_details
methods.description: Retrieves account parent information for given invoices.

methods.name: get_supplier_details
methods.description: Retrieves supplier group details for a list of suppliers.
